branches.conclusion: The current institute graduate-option inventory and 2026–27 graduate-option regulations were read for Applied and Computational Mathematics, Computational Science and Engineering (minor only), Computer Science, Computing and Mathematical Sciences, Control and Dynamical Systems, Information and Data Science, and Mathematics. None names Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering as a doctoral option or formal doctoral field. Operations Research in the CMS description is faculty involvement only. Other engineering option titles in the institute inventory do not match the owner title rule.

Caltech’s complete graduate-option inventory has no business/management graduate option. The Social Science PhD option regulations describe economics and political science, with no named Operations or Management Science doctoral field; undergraduate Business, Economics, and Management courses are not a doctorate.
